北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天晴朗但体感 1℃，出门记得多穿衣物哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels like 1℃. Remember to dress warmly when going out!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天体感 8℃，注意保暖，别着凉啦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and feels like 8℃. Keep warm to avoid catching a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天体感 6℃，微凉，记得添衣哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like 6℃ and a bit cool. Remember to add a layer!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云暖和，体感 17℃，湿度较大，注意防潮。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and warm, feels like 17℃. High humidity, mind the dampness.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 17℃，舒适但湿度高，记得多喝水。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 17℃. Comfortable but humid, remember to hydrate.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天风大体感 6℃，出门注意防风保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy with strong winds, feels like 6℃. Dress warmly and mind the wind.
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感 3℃，天虽多云但有点冷，出门记得加衣。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels like 3℃, cloudy and a bit cold. Remember to add layers when going out.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阳光正好，体感 7℃，微凉舒适，尽情享受吧！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and feels like a comfortable 7℃. Enjoy the beautiful weather!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾弥漫，体感 2℃，请注意出行安全和保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is very foggy and feels like 2℃. Please be safe and keep warm when traveling.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗干燥，体感 6℃，注意补水保湿哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and dry, feels like 6℃. Remember to hydrate and moisturize.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云体感 9℃，微凉，出门注意适时添减衣物。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 9℃ and a bit cool. Remember to adjust your clothing accordingly.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -16℃ 并有霾，务必穿暖防寒，戴好口罩。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -16℃ with haze. Dress extremely warmly, protect yourself from cold, and wear a mask.
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳天晴但体感 -5℃，出门注意防寒保暖哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels like -5℃. Remember to keep warm when going out!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚体感 15℃，暖和舒适，记得防晒。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and feels like a warm 15℃. Enjoy the comfortable weather and remember sunscreen.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云体感 11℃，湿度较高，注意出行添衣。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 11℃. High humidity, remember to dress for the weather.
厦门.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降8℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，体感 0℃，注意保暖和交通安全。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy and feels like 0℃. Keep warm and mind traffic safety.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾，体感 -2℃，出门注意安全，多穿点哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy and feels like -2℃. Be safe, dress warmly when going out!
